suite: TodoMaster Google Tasks Production E2E & Multi-Device Testing Matrix

cloudPlatform.recommendedPlan: Spark Free Tier (5 Physical + 10 Virtual Devices/day) or Google Cloud DDP

testCases.title: Quick Demo One-Click Sign-In & JWT Session Initialization
preconditions: App is fresh launched on physical or virtual device
Device has valid network connectivity or localhost reverse forwarding
steps: Launch application com.todomaster.app
Locate Auth Screen container
Click on button '🚀 Quick Demo Sign-In'
Wait for asynchronous network auth handshake (me.php / login.php)
testCases.expectedResult: User is authenticated with valid JWT token; Auth modal closes; 'Tasks' header and 'My Tasks' tab bar become visible with zero UI clipping.

testCases.title: Multi-Tenant Data Isolation & Secure Password Storage
preconditions: Database is running with schema migration v1 applied (users and todos tables)
Backend password_hash() using BCRYPT is enabled
steps: Register User A (userA@test.com) and create task 'User A Private Secret'
Log out or switch account to User B (userB@test.com)
Fetch todos endpoint /api/todos/index.php
testCases.expectedResult: User B cannot view or modify User A's tasks; HTTP 200 returns exclusively User B's scoped rows; Passwords in database stored as $2y$10$... bcrypt hashes.

testCases.title: Minimalist Task Creation via Floating Action Button (+)
preconditions: User is authenticated on 'My Tasks' screen
steps: Tap Floating Action Button (+)
Verify 'New Task' bottom sheet opens smoothly within frame budget (< 16.6ms)
Input title 'Firebase Cloud Device Robo Test Task' into 'Enter task title'
Input details 'Automated verification of full lifecycle' into 'Add details'
Tap 'Save'
testCases.expectedResult: Bottom sheet dismisses; new task appears at the top of 'My Tasks' list with circular uncompleted checkbox '◯'; DB query latency < 20ms.
testCases.assertionRule: assertVisible('Firebase Cloud Device Robo Test Task')

testCases.title: Complete Task via Circular Checkbox (◯ ➔ ●)
preconditions: Task 'Firebase Cloud Device Robo Test Task' exists in pending state
steps: Tap circular checkbox '◯' on task item
Verify optimistic UI update triggers instantly (0ms latency)
Verify strike-through animation executes within 8.33ms / 16.6ms frame budget
Wait for asynchronous PUT /api/todos/update.php (status_id = 2)
testCases.expectedResult: Task is marked completed, disappears from 'My Tasks' pending list, and counter increments in 'Completed' tab.
testCases.assertionRule: assertNotVisible('Firebase Cloud Device Robo Test Task', scope='My Tasks')

testCases.title: Completed Tab Filtering & Completed Task Retention
preconditions: At least one task has been toggled to completed status
steps: Tap 'Completed' tab in the top tab navigator
Observe completed task list animation
Verify completed task shows filled circular checkbox '●' and strikethrough text
testCases.expectedResult: Completed tasks list renders accurately; 'Firebase Cloud Device Robo Test Task' is visible with status 2.
testCases.assertionRule: assertVisible('Completed') AND assertVisible('Firebase Cloud Device Robo Test Task')

testCases.title: In-Place Task Title and Details Editing
preconditions: Task exists in the active view
steps: Tap on task title 'Firebase Cloud Device Robo Test Task'
Verify 'Edit Task' modal/bottom sheet opens
Modify title to 'Firebase Cloud Device Robo Test Task (Edited)'
Tap 'Save'
testCases.expectedResult: Edit modal closes; updated title reflects immediately in the list; PUT /api/todos/update.php completes under 15ms.
testCases.assertionRule: assertVisible('Firebase Cloud Device Robo Test Task (Edited)')

testCases.title: Task Removal via Delete Action (✕)
preconditions: Task exists in the active view
steps: Tap delete action icon '✕' (or 'Delete task')
Observe removal animation
Wait for DELETE /api/todos/delete.php execution
testCases.expectedResult: Task is permanently removed from the view and database; list re-renders smoothly with 0 jank.
testCases.assertionRule: assertNotVisible('Firebase Cloud Device Robo Test Task (Edited)')

testCases.title: UI Thread Tranquility & 60 FPS Frame Render Validation
preconditions: App running in Release mode with Hermes AOT bytecode engine enabled
steps: Record gfxinfo via adb shell dumpsys gfxinfo com.todomaster.app framestats
Perform 10 consecutive fast scroll actions up and down through 50 tasks
Calculate p50, p90, and p95 frame render times
testCases.expectedResult: p50 render time is <= 7 ms (< 16.6 ms budget); Janky frame percentage is < 1.0%; No UI freezes on main thread.

testCases.title: RAM Heap Discipline & Zero Memory Leak Growth Validation
steps: Record initial heap via adb shell dumpsys meminfo com.todomaster.app
Execute 10 complete cycles of modal open ➔ create ➔ edit ➔ close ➔ navigate tabs
Trigger system GC via dumpsys meminfo com.todomaster.app
Measure retained heap growth difference (Cycle 10 Heap - Baseline Heap)
testCases.expectedResult: Idle RAM Heap remains < 65 MB (baseline measured 43.5 MB); Retained leak growth is exactly 0 MB.

testCases.title: Zero WakeLock Leak & Power Consumption Compliance
preconditions: App running on battery-powered physical device
steps: Inspect active wake locks via adb shell dumpsys power
Inspect app background CPU usage via dumpsys cpuinfo
Leave app backgrounded for 60 seconds
testCases.expectedResult: Active Wake Locks count is exactly 0; Idle CPU usage is < 0.001s; Zero battery drain.

testCases.title: Graceful Network Fallback & Clear Error Boundary
preconditions: Simulate airplane mode or severed server connection
steps: Attempt to create a task while offline
Observe UI behavior
testCases.expectedResult: App does not crash or show unhandled RedScreen; displays friendly non-blocking notification or caches operation gracefully.
